points: 11 tasks in five categories taken from Epoch's own work, six models tested
Claude Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra roughly tied for the lead
Each task ran once per model, so scores are noisy
take: Frontier models handle well-defined analysis reliably but fail at open-ended research. Temper plans to automate knowledge work end to end.
title: Epoch AI: models cannot yet do a research team's open-ended work
